verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents a built-in AI assistant inside the Billing UI that can 'answer questions and complete tasks' and draft pricing/product configurations from a description, showing real in-product task delegation (chargebee-docs-16, chargebee-docs-14). However, the primary AI-native evidence emphasizes MCP servers for external AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) rather than a deeply documented native assistant experience, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the in-app assistant's task scope or reliability. missing for 10: independent verification of the built-in assistant's capabilities, detail on task types beyond drafting/answering, and community evidence confirming real-world use.
